metadata.title: System Center DPM 2012 (R2) HTML Report
metadata.description:
This script Create and send a protection group backup report of System Center Data Protection Manager (DPM) 2012 (R2) Servers based on the recovery points and protection groups
Usage: DPMProtectionGroupReport.ps1 [-DPMServers <string[]>] [-ProtectionGroups <string[]>] [-MinLastBackupHours <int>] [-MinRecoveryPoints <int>] [ReportLocation <string>] [SMTPServer <string>] [Recipient <string[]>] [Sender <string>] [Username <string>] [Password <string>] [-SSL <True | False>] [Port <int>]

findings.title: Possible hard-coded credential
findings.description: A credential-like variable appears to be assigned a literal value. Review the source; the matched value is redacted.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
